$comment: Real-world example: preparing an in-person event about AI agents. Due dates are relative offsets in days from the run date, so the example never goes stale. task_level drives XP (the server currently caps the effective level around 10). Subquest counts vary on purpose (0-4). Optional quest `status` and per-subquest `status` (todo|in_progress|blocked|done) seed a believable mid-prep state; marking a quest or subquest `done` awards XP once, exactly like the app.

campaigns.name: AI Agents Summit — Event Prep
campaigns.description: Plan and run a one-day in-person event introducing AI agents to ~80 attendees: venue, catering, budget, speakers, talks/demos, registration, and on-site logistics.

quests.description: Book the venue for the summit

subquests.description: Check A/V setup and reliable wifi for the demo
Confirm the date is available and hold it

subquests: Collect dietary restrictions from the registration form
Pick a menu with vegetarian and vegan options
Confirm final headcount and place the order
Raise a PO and forward the invoice to finance

quests.description: Prepare the opening keynote slides: "What are AI agents?"

subquests.description: Outline the story: agents vs. plain chatbots
Draft the slides and add a real-world example

subquests: Get feedback from a colleague and revise

quests.description: Build and rehearse a live agent demo
subquests: Pick a use case that shows tool use clearly
Test the demo on the venue's wifi
Record a fallback video in case the live demo fails

quests.description: Invite speakers and lock the agenda

subquests.description: Send invites and collect speaker bios and talk titles
Create the signup form with a capacity cap
Send the save-the-date to the mailing list

quests.description: Send the attendee reminder email the day before
